integrity: A mathematical proof and standalone exact-rational finite checks are included; historical priority is subject to additional literature review, and no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only strict real permutahedra, strictly positive fixed diagonal quadratic weights, and ordinary coordinate-maximum errors; no result for repeated generating ranks, non-diagonal metrics, other norms, or nonlinear Bregman objectives. Finite checks supplement an analytic proof; independently audited priority and correctness are not claimed.
title: Sharp diagonal-metric coordinatewise sensitivity of strict permutahedral projection
